runtimeValidation: Same schema compiled by pinned Ajv, with pinned runtime helpers bundled into the generated executable; no new dependency or immutable release changes.
contractDigest: SHA-256 of bounded canonical JSON including owner, kind, ID, revision, body and source references, excluding only digest. Reference model is normative shape; new version explicitly binds contract identity and revision.
compactTransport: Lossless bounded deflate/base64 envelope of the exact generated ContextPacket schema; decode revalidates effective digest and complete contract source closure.
recovery: Dispatch/resume require an explicit effective digest and an exact owner-provided historical graph. No latest lookup exists in the resolver.

graphFamilies.ownership: Domain parent, Project primary Domain, Work Project, Task Work
graphFamilies.refinement: Task parent chain plus typed Issue/Spec/Plan Work refinement
graphFamilies.dependency: Acyclic execution prerequisites with exact cross-Work artifact revision/digest
graphFamilies.delegation: Typed source authority references; source graph grants no native permission
graphFamilies.knowledge: Cyclic relatedTo relations and source-qualified provenance
graphFamilies.nativeCorrelation: Nullable native observations, separate from logical source identity and authority

allocation.idSource: node:crypto.randomUUID (opaque UUIDv4; caller cannot select a canonical ID)
allocation.requestKey: Owner-global ownerId/createRequestId; meaning/kind/scope bound by canonical request digest
allocation.recordRoot: work/<project>/<work>/v3/ (new side-by-side version; all legacy records/fences remain unchanged)
allocation.transaction: One existing Git owner ref compare-and-swap publishes mapping, record, companion contracts and collision index. Temporary index/object construction never checks out files.
allocation.ownerBoundary: NativeGitIdentityOwner.withCurrentAuthority must authenticate full operation, actual owner membership/current authority and hold its native authority lease across the callback/CAS. JSON witnesses are not a CLI credential.
allocation.graphSourceBoundary: Native owner provides exact selected Domain/Project source semantics. Every v3 Work/Task/contract projection is compared against actual immutable selected Git record bytes before publication.
allocation.checkoutBoundary: A checked-out owner ref is refused. Native owner must qualify an unoccupied branch/bare Git record transaction; common code does not mutate checkout, trust or configuration.
allocation.retryBoundary: No ref/commit mutation retry. Known/uncertain CAS outcomes are reconciled once against exact current request mapping and record/contract receipts, otherwise held for owner observation.
allocation.runBoundary: Initial Run only reserves, binds effective digest/source/authority, uses a distinct next attempt, and has no native bindings/effects. No native execution/adoption is granted.
allocation.templates: Explicit {$allocatedId:true} and earlier {$contractRef:index} tokens. Derive contract digests after ID rendering; validate all generated records and contract closure before CAS.
allocation.cli: Existing harness context-v3 and allocate-v3; explicit dry-run performs no allocation/publication. Apply requires a native owner adapter supplied to runHarness by the actual runtime owner. No dynamic module, credential bridge or global native configuration.

compatibility.v1v2Semantics: Explicit canonical legacy-v3 read/admission/recovery adapter preserves original sources and per-Task historical contracts, unknown Issue text and unsupported v2 holds. One native-qualified CAS sets the v3 authoritative writer fence; legacy transition authoring then rejects. No native adoption performed.
compatibility.historicalReleases: All original 0.1.0/0.2.0 artifacts and consumer pins unchanged.
compatibility.unsupportedInputs: Unknown fields, wrong scoped refs, stale revisions/digests, missing coverage, cycles and unqualified native owners reject.

verification: Meaningful synthetic Graph, codec, Git CAS, process-concurrency/restart/conflict/collision/uncertain-CAS, scoped owner denial and historical preservation tests in v3*.test.ts; execute exclusively in the qualified isolated source runner.

corrections.legacyBridge: legacy-bridge.ts: explicit existing-scope admission, immutable inventory, typed locator aliases and prior bootstrap mapping; never random allocation
corrections.artifactQualification: external-artifacts.ts: actual canonical Work/Task/contract source closures plus pinned producer context/artifact/gate/selection/criterion/receiver sources, checked by the single effective resolver
corrections.creationReplay: immutable ledger and Git creation blobs plus bounded same-identity successor lineage/current source graph validation
corrections.gitHooks: native current per-invocation no-Git-hooks policy required before writes, exact head/owner/ref/authority/expiry; per-command Git override only; no Codex /hooks or global config change
corrections.qualityBoundary: New correction sources require Root registry/quality/provider successor pins. No native adoption or publication.

residualCorrections.R01: Evaluate exact legacy selected dependencies using canonical records.ts dependencyFindings and original GitWorkReader; carry scoped dynamic holds, prevent removal/change of source edges and preserve separate acceptance qualification. Unrelated ready Tasks are unaffected.
residualCorrections.R02: Canonical pinned v3/graph.json semantic source projection is checked against actual canonical Work/Task/contract blobs at the same snapshot. The one resolver reconstructs the complete producer effective contract and compares packet/current graph. Proof fingerprints bind the exact graph; any graph mutation requires fresh actual source qualification. Upstream closures without actual proof remain unsupported/held, never accepted from packet self-digests.
residualCorrections.R03: Bounded full parent DAG (maximum8192 complete non-shallow commits) finds one actual introducing transaction; merge propagation is distinct from mutation. Every side-parent ledger deletion/rewrite and every relevant successor edge is checked, including removed/foreign/regressed side history restored at head. No ref retry or source history rewriting.
residualCorrections.R04: Preserved resolved exact native-qualified per-invocation hook policy and existing positive/negative/lost-ACK tests.
residualCorrections.nativeSourceRequirement: External artifact native owner must publish an exact canonical semantic graph source projection without embedded external proof rows at work/<project>/<work>/v3/graph.json, pin it alongside actual records, and retain native controls. This source slice performs no publication/adoption or native owner permission issuance.

refreshQualification.boundary: Every public source refresh (context, legacy and artifact) revokes graph/legacy/artifact proof at entry before schema validation, source reads, aliases or joins. Alias qualification belongs to that same graph transaction; no separate alias authority is inferred.
refreshQualification.publication: An unexposed detached graph stages all legacy, alias and artifact phases, whole-graph validation and final requested context transport/digest checks. Only a complete unchanged/current refresh transfers proofs synchronously to original objects. All staging proofs are discarded on completion/rejection.
refreshQualification.isolation: Actual source documents are cloned before internal graph qualification, and readers receive only TaskRef fields. Neither original nor partially staged proof becomes available during source callbacks.
refreshQualification.concurrency: A private per-graph refresh epoch prevents older completion from overwriting a newer refresh; no IDs, effects or native permissions are allocated.
refreshQualification.preservation: One effective resolver, all scoped holds, supported full merge ancestry, native-qualified hook policy and prior positive/negative/lost-ACK tests remain unchanged.
